caption: The drawing features a background filled with diagonal shading in gray and greenish hues, covering most of the area within a rectangular boundary. In the lower left quadrant, there is a large blue outline of a left hand with visible details for fingers and knuckles. Towards the right center, there is a stacked, vertically oriented abstract shape outlined in blue and red, with several enclosed geometric areas—the uppermost section contains two red triangles and a red rectangle, resembling a face. Below this, parallel vertical blue lines are enclosed, intersected by a horizontal red band. A thick yellow ring encircles part of the middle section, and to its left, a solid blue circular shape appears. Additional blue vertical lines and a red horizontal band occupy the lower part of the vertical shape. The outlined objects and geometric arrangements are distinct from the shaded background and contain saturated colors of blue, red, and yellow.
title: Petroglyph
